query: Set up GitHub Actions CI for this package.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/ci.md before writing
Puts the suite behind one local command (Makefile target or script) that CI only calls
Pins actions to a commit SHA and the toolchain version in one place both laptop and CI read
Sets default permissions to none and grants only contents: read
Cancels superseded runs on PRs only, not on main
Gives the job a timeout

query: Write a script that releases this package to PyPI.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/releases.md and reference/publishing.md before writing
Separates build (no secrets) from publish, and publishes the exact bytes it built and tested
Resolves remote main to a SHA and releases that frozen commit; never tags from the local checkout
Writes a manifest with a checksum per file and asserts the built set equals an explicit expected list
Asserts preconditions before upload (version is new or a partial publish of the same bytes, CI passed) and skips steps already done
Stops and asks before the first upload, and prefers trusted publishing (OIDC) over a long-lived token
Verifies from the public registry after publishing

query: We want to rename the `attempts` parameter to `max_attempts` and ship it in the next release. Make the change and prepare the release.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/compatibility.md and reference/releases.md before acting
Identifies the rename as a contract break for callers of the last release
Prefers deprecation: keeps `attempts` working with a warning for at least one release, or explains why not
If the break is declared, requires a breaking changelog entry with a migration note and a major bump
Stops and asks before declaring a break or publishing; does not publish or tag on its own

query: Rename the users.fullname column to users.display_name in our web service's Postgres database and update the code. We deploy with rolling restarts.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/migrations.md before writing the migration
Does not rename in place: adds display_name, writes both columns, backfills, switches reads, then stops writing fullname
Ships the schema expansion and the code that depends on it in separate deploys
Backfills in bounded, resumable batches off the request path, with a lock timeout on the migration
Leaves dropping fullname for a later deploy and stops to ask before it, after showing the column is unused

query: I've finished the retry-budget feature and a cleanup of the logging module in this working tree. Commit it and open a PR.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/commits-and-prs.md before committing
Splits the work into separate commits: the logging cleanup apart from the retry-budget behavior change
Follows the repo's commit message convention from git log, and each body says why
Reviews the staged diff for secrets, debug output, and unrelated files, and commits only paths changed for this task
Writes a PR description with what changed and why, how it was verified, what was left alone, and open risks; does not force-push

query: We're launching the new pricing engine to production next week. Plan the deploy.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/deploys.md before writing the plan
Puts the new engine behind a flag that defaults off, read through config, with an owner and a removal date
Plans a canary with advance, hold, and roll-back thresholds written down before it starts
Writes the rollback plan first, including what happens to data the new version wrote, and keeps rollback inside the N-1..N window
Lists the post-deploy checks from outside and names who watches the first hour
